title: Answer Every Contractor Lead Fast
summary: Qualify roofing and trade inquiries, answer the phone, and reply to reviews so fewer jobs go to the next quote.

money_potential.label: High
money_potential.basis: Assumes each home-service job is high value, so winning a few more jobs matters.
money_potential.note: Money tiers are our estimates (labelled Estimate) of relative earning potential, each with its assumption. They are not promises, income claims or advice. Results depend on your market, offer and effort.

how_it_makes_money: Fast, complete replies win more of the jobs you already paid to attract.
Missed calls get answered and booked.
who_its_for: Roofers, contractors and other home-service businesses.

steps: Add Legend Lead Ops and give it your services and service area.
Test it on a few past inquiries.
Decide whether you need phone answering, and check its plan first.
Use Reply Desk for reviews and messages.
guardrails: Quotes and messages stay drafts until you approve them.
Check the phone plan's current price before signing up.

claims.text: The creator reports about 20 to 30 minutes saved per lead versus writing follow-ups by hand, in a demo on synthetic leads.
